name: Catnip & Coffee
detailed_description:
Catnip & Coffee is a cozy idle management game where you choose your own cat companion and guide the growth of a charming coffee shop. Rebuild your dream café, expand your purr-suit of profits, and relax as your tiny feline partner helps your business bloom—all from a peaceful, relaxing view.

☕ Idle Catnip and Coffee
Pick your cat and let the business begin. From the moment you start, your café quietly earns income in the background—perfect for studying, working, or just winding down.

📈 Manage and Improve
Buy and upgrade shops, unlock new revenue streams, and rebuild your ideal café. Use simple point-and-click controls to grow your coffee empire one cozy step at a time.

🐾 Your Mini Business Partner
Your cat may be small, but they’re all business—working behind the scenes to keep the shop running and earning coins while you focus on other things. Whether you're lounging, managing upgrades, hunting for collectables, playing minigames, or chatting with frogs, your cat will be the perfect desk companion. Great for multi-monitor setups—always present, never in the way.

🎧 Focus-Friendly Audio
Mix and match multiple relaxing music and sound effects—including three albums across different genres and a dynamic weather system that shifts from sunny days to stormy nights—to create the perfect vibe. Whether you’re deep in a task or just chilling, Catnip & Coffee helps set the tone.
